name: spreadsheet
description: Inspect spreadsheets, progressively obtain operation contracts, and execute XLSX/CSV/TSV work through a bounded host runtime.

interface.shortDescription: Work with XLSX, CSV, and TSV files through a progressive protocol.
interface.longDescription: Give the model bounded XLSX inspection, validation, creation, and update capabilities plus server-side CSV/TSV inspection, template filling, and export. The model first inspects a resource, then requests only the selected operation's contract, then executes it. Desktop workbook preview is an independent application capability.
interface.defaultPrompt: For spreadsheet work use spreadsheet_inspect, spreadsheet_describe, then spreadsheet_execute. Describe returns the exact operation schema so do not guess optional fields. For CSV/TSV-to-XLSX template tasks, choose fill_template; the tool handles quoted commas, quoted newlines, duplicate headers, writing, and reopen validation server-side. Use validate for XLSX verification; do not use PDF or manually unpack OOXML unless the spreadsheet protocol reports an unsupported workbook feature. The legacy spreadsheet tool remains only for compatibility.
capabilities: Cell finding and conditional row filtering
